parts.name: Slotted tube
parts.notes: Machined part. Stock: 2.5" OD x 0.065" wall x 2.37" ID 6061-T6 seamless tube (OnlineMetals #23883, also McMaster). Shop ops (kept minimal): saw + face to 104.0 mm, mill one 14 mm wide x 70 mm full-radius slot on the front (18-88 mm from the bottom end), drill 2 x 3.4 mm holes at the back 24 mm apart, 4 mm from the bottom end, deburr, Type II anodize black (or clear). Estimate ~$130 for 1 (setup + anodize lot charge), ~$40 each at 10, ~$14 at 100, ~$8 at 500. Cheapest one-off: skip anodizing and ask for a brushed (Scotch-Brite) finish, saves the ~$75 anodize minimum.

parts.name: ESP32-CAM (AI-Thinker) + ESP32-CAM-MB kit
parts.notes: ESP32-CAM + OV2640 + ESP32-CAM-MB (CH340, micro-USB, used only for flashing). Board 27 x 40.5 x 4.5 mm (Ai-Thinker datasheet), MB 40 x 27 x 10 mm. Price estimated, check listing.

parts.name: TP4056 USB-C charger
parts.notes: TP4056 USB-C module WITH protection (DW01, OUT+/OUT- pads), 28 x 17 x 4 mm. Search "TP4056 USB-C protection".

parts.name: MT3608 boost 5V
parts.notes: MT3608 boost module 36 x 17 x 6 mm; set the trim pot to 5.1 V before fitting. Search "MT3608 boost module".

parts.name: JST-PH 2-pin pigtail pair
parts.notes: Plug between boost and ESP32-CAM: unplug it before flashing over the MB's micro-USB. Search "JST PH 2.0 2 pin pigtail".

parts.name: AS568-035 Buna-N O-ring
parts.notes: 56.87 mm ID x 1.78 mm CS. Twist-cap friction and retention. Search "AS568-035 Buna-N O-ring".

parts.name: Solar panel 5V 53x30
parts.notes: NUZAMAS 4-pack, 53 x 30 x 2 mm, 5 V 30 mA (Voc 5.5 V). Sits in a 1.5 mm pocket in the twist cap. Trickle charge only: ~0.15 W in full sun, a few mW indoors. Price per panel estimated from the 4-pack.

parts.notes: Blocks USB 5 V from back-feeding the panel. Search "1N5819 Schottky diode".
